relationships.subject: ECM proteolysis
relationships.evidence_quote: ECM proteolysis, mediated by multiple hydrolases in the extracellular space, plays an initiating role in this process

relationships.subject: intervertebral disc degeneration
relationships.evidence_quote: Disc degeneration has been implicated as a major cause of lower back pain

key_findings: Review: proteases-mediated ECM proteolysis drives disc degeneration, with collagen II to I shift and aggrecan cleavage.
Targeting ECM proteases is proposed as an intervention for disc degeneration.
